Package de.hof.dms.domain

Class Department

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.domain.Department
public class Department extends Object
Persistent entity for a department, stored in the MongoDB departments collection. This collection is the application's department registry; the normalized code (e.g. ITDLZ) is the value referenced by Keycloak user attributes, JWT department claims, and FolderAcl department lists. The code is immutable after creation because those references are plain strings; departments that are no longer used are deactivated rather than renamed or deleted.
